note: W6 (OKNA §5): coupling of window parameters. Everything here is a preset or an example list (CLAUDE.md: lists are examples, defaults are presets): parameter names, channels, dependency kinds, menu templates, icons, words, the iteration limit. A new dependency = an entry here + a pure function in shell/windows/dependencies.ts registered by id; an id without a function is not refused, the window says it is unknown.
max_iterations_note: Propagation runs to a fixed point; a loop that does not settle stops after this many rounds with the last values and the advisory coupling_cycle (preset 8, any number; 0 = no propagation).
modes_note: The vocabulary of §5.1; an unknown mode is read as independent with the advisory unknown_binding (nothing is dropped).
channels_note: A seed of channel names (examples). Any string names a channel.
kind_params_note: Which parameters a window of a kind actually reads and writes today (no fake controls: a parameter appears in the menu ⋯ only where a component follows it). Open: a kind not listed offers nothing yet. W7 gap: focus node, perspective, time position and mapping of the navigator.
menu_templates_note: Examples of what the menu ⋯ of a window offers per parameter and per other window; any dependency (offset, expression…) is a binding in data and also comes from the layout file or a sentence later (W7).

text.pl: Parametry są powiązane w kółko: {path}. Wartości mogą się nie uzgodnić; przeliczanie staje po {max} krokach.
text.en: The parameters are bound in a loop: {path}. The values may not settle; recalculation stops after {max} rounds.

text.pl: Parametry są powiązane w kółko równościami: {path}. Wartości się zgadzają.
text.en: The parameters are bound in a loop of equalities: {path}. The values agree.

text.pl: Okno «{title}» ma {param} powiązane z oknem, którego już nie ma; trzyma ostatnią wartość.
text.en: The window «{title}» has {param} bound to a window that is gone; it keeps the last value.

text.pl: Okno «{title}»: zależność «{kind}» nieznana; {param} trzyma ostatnią wartość.
text.en: Window «{title}»: dependency «{kind}» is unknown; {param} keeps the last value.

text.pl: Okno «{title}»: wyrażenie {param} jest błędne ({error}); trzyma ostatnią wartość.
text.en: Window «{title}»: the expression of {param} is invalid ({error}); it keeps the last value.

text.pl: Okno «{title}»: tryb wiązania «{mode}» nieznany; {param} działa jak niezależne.
text.en: Window «{title}»: binding mode «{mode}» is unknown; {param} acts as independent.
